Technical Delivery Manager — Outside IR35
Location: Bristol / Hybrid (3 days per week onsite)
Rate: £550–£650 per day
Duration: 9 months
IR35 Status: Outside IR35

The Opportunity:
A major UK aviation group is seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead a strategic platform re-engineering programme. You will be responsible for coordinating 4–6 cross-functional squads delivering microservices migration from a legacy monolith.

Your Responsibilities:
- Own end-to-end delivery across 4–6 Agile squads (40+ engineers)
- Run SAFe Programme Increment planning events and manage PI objectives
- Manage £5M+ programme budget, forecast and report to ExCo monthly
- Resolve delivery blockers, manage dependencies, escalate risks appropriately
- Coordinate with third-party vendors and offshore teams (India)
- Define and track delivery metrics: velocity, cycle time, deployment frequency, MTTR
- Drive adoption of DevOps practices: CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code
- Stakeholder management: CTO, CPO, and programme board reporting
- Lead sprint reviews, retrospectives, and quarterly business reviews

What You Must Have:
- 10+ years delivering complex technology programmes
- SAFe Agilist certification (SA or SPC preferred)
- Experience managing offshore and distributed delivery teams
- Strong understanding of cloud delivery on AWS or Azure
- Excellent stakeholder management at director and C-suite level
- Track record of managing multi-million pound budgets
- PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management qualification

Good to Have:
- Aviation, transport or regulated industry background
- Experience with JIRA Advanced Roadmaps, Confluence, and programme reporting tools
- Knowledge of DORA metrics and engineering effectiveness
- Agile coaching experience at programme level

We Need Someone Who:
Can balance people leadership with programme governance. Strong on process but pragmatic in delivery. Able to hold difficult conversations with both technical teams and senior stakeholders.
